versions.changelog:
gmgn-track 1.4.6

- Added support for tracking which tokens a wallet has followed/bookmarked on GMGN (via the `track follow-tokens` sub-command).
- Expanded argument hints and sub-command list to include wallet followed tokens and token groups.
- Updated rate limits from 10 to 20 and added corresponding adjustments to leaky-bucket limiter details.
- Minor updates to prerequisites and command usage instructions.
- Removed the skill-card.md file.

gmgn-track 1.2.9

- Added support for tracking on the Ethereum (eth) chain in addition to Solana, BSC, and Base.
- Updated usage instructions and argument hints to include "eth" as a supported chain.
- Clarified that GMGN_PRIVATE_KEY is now required only for `track follow-wallet` (not for kol/smartmoney).
- Improved first-time setup instructions to save both API key and private key for follow-wallet tracking.
- Minor improvements to documentation and descriptions for clarity.

gmgn-track 1.2.8 changelog

- Updated the skill description for clearer, more concise messaging focused on copy-trading, alpha, and whale tracking use cases.
- Clarified and shortened the audience definitions and scope in the introductory section.
- Made usage scenarios and command guidance more straightforward.
- No internal logic or functional changes were made.

gmgn-track 1.2.7 changelog

- Updated description for greater clarity, specifying primary use cases and referring users to gmgn-portfolio for deep wallet analysis.
- Improved detail on sub-command intent and data separation between follow-wallet, KOL, and smartmoney sources.
- Enhanced guidance on when to use each sub-command and on how to interpret key fields.
- General text refinements for easier understanding of concepts and usage.  
- No functional or file changes; documentation-only update.

gmgn-track 1.2.5

- Updated skill description for improved clarity: "crypto token trading activity" replaces "trade activity".
- No changes to functionality or CLI usage.
- No file changes detected; documentation only update.

gmgn-track 1.2.5

- Updated documentation for clarity: clarified that an API Key is required for all sub-commands and a private key is no longer needed for "follow-wallet" calls.
- Corrected description of "follow-wallet" logic: follow list is now user-specific and resolved from the API Key, not a private key.
- Improved and condensed skill description to highlight use cases and supported blockchains.
- Removed outdated first-time setup instructions relating to private key; first-time API key setup now requires only the API Key.
- No functional or interface changes—documentation and guidance only.

gmgn-track 1.2.3 Changelog

- Added explicit documentation for rate limit handling, including cooldown instructions and `reset_at` handling for 429 errors.
- Clarified that all tracking routes use a leaky-bucket limiter, listing exact command weights and burst/throughput constraints.
- Reduced and streamlined the description, emphasizing major sub-commands and removing extensive field tables and verbose metadata.
- Updated metadata to include `cliHelp` field.
- No changes to core CLI usage or command structure.

Initial release. Track smart money, KOL wallets, and followed wallets on Solana, BNB Chain, and Base Chain — real-time on-chain trade signals and copy trading insights for meme coins, pump.fun and four.meme tokens via GMGN.
